--- 9aec/cmake/builtins.cmake
+++ streaming/cmake/builtins.cmake
@@ -307,3 +307,12 @@
 if(NODE_CRYPTO_AUDITED_BORROW AND NOT NODE_COMPAT_CRYPTO_HASH_HMAC)
     message(FATAL_ERROR "NODE_CRYPTO_AUDITED_BORROW requires NODE_COMPAT_CRYPTO_HASH_HMAC")
 endif()
+
+option(NODE_COMPAT_ZLIB_STREAMING "Enable bounded native Gzip/Deflate classic streams" OFF)
+if(NODE_COMPAT_ZLIB_STREAMING AND NOT CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
+    if(NOT TARGET builtin_node_compat OR NOT NODE_COMPAT_ZLIB OR NOT NODE_COMPAT_CLASSIC_STREAMS OR NOT NODE_COMPAT_INTERNAL_TICKS)
+        message(FATAL_ERROR "NODE_COMPAT_ZLIB_STREAMING requires node zlib, classic streams and internal ticks")
+    endif()
+    target_sources(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE builtins/node-compat/zlib/stream-kernel.cpp)
+    target_compile_definitions(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE NODE_COMPAT_ZLIB_STREAMING=1)
+endif()
